column1: Set a rack in the lower third of the oven, preheat to 350°F (177°C), and grease a 9x5-inch loaf pan.
Whisk the flour, baking soda, salt, and cinnamon in a medium bowl.
Beat the butter and brown sugar on medium-high about 3 minutes until light.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the mashed bananas, yogurt or sour cream, and vanilla.
Mix in the dry ingredients on low just until combined, then fold in nuts or chocolate chips if using.
Spread the thick batter in the pan.
Bake 60–65 minutes, tenting loosely with foil halfway through, until a toothpick comes out with only a few moist crumbs.
Cool in the pan on a rack for 1 hour, then turn out and cool completely before slicing.
